assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Removing the default install seal or registered resolver roots allows the wrapper redirect, yielding returncode 0, absent read-only refusal and changed independently captured pre-write size/mtime/digest.
A seal or mount composition that damages rather than preserves executable content makes the post-refusal executable marker differ or execution raise.
Omitting resolved_environment while retaining only interpreter targets permits the package redirect and changes its independently captured file identity.
Failing to rebind the run, worktree or scratch writable makes the wrapper fail or prevents the exact literal output from being stored.
The control fails if removing the install root does not permit a real overwrite: refusal, unchanged pre-write identity or missing replacement bytes turns it red.

Replacing shared resolver calls with hard-coded .venv resolution loses alternate, omitting interpreter discovery loses target, and passing the wrong repository or never calling the resolver fails the recorded call set; these injected-path assertions detect failure to honor the resolver rather than claiming real resolver correctness.
Ignoring either supported install setting permits the actual shell overwrite and removes the read-only refusal or changes pre-write identity.

Caching environment resolution across compositions, ignoring the registered symlink, or accumulating obsolete roots fails first-environment, replacement-environment or obsolete-root exclusion assertions respectively.
Swallowing the registry parser error and returning an empty root set fails the expected FlightConfigError readable-JSON refusal.
